report.notes: R3-01: untrusted._is_domain now blocks by default: any label<dot>label with a 2+ letter last label is a link in any case; the _TLDS/case/hyphen rules no longer decide. Two exceptions remain: a missing space before one of a few non-domain words (_SENTENCE_WORDS: the/then/this/that/these/those/they/été/ete), and the ideographic full stop between two Chinese/Japanese runs unless the second run is in _IDN_TLDS (still list-based; disclosed). Added spaced defangs ([.], ( . ), [dot], (dot), ' dot ', ' . ') to _DOT and a phone pattern (8+ digits, dates and year ranges excluded). mask_links masks the whole matched span across words, look-alike characters included. Existing precision tests left unchanged instead of rewritten as the diagnosis proposed, because rewriting them would weaken existing tests. Not checked: whether the _SENTENCE_WORDS entries are real domain endings (IANA download blocked by the proxy). R3-02: _excerpt matches every claim word in order; the claim may add only determiners; the source may leave out only determiners, or one determiner plus at most MAX_GAP_WORDS words that are not function words (noun-phrase modifiers). Kept because tests d7_verbatim_numbers:40 and r2:140 require 'after a long public consultation' -> 'after consultation' to stay unquoted. states_quantity on the skipped text is kept only as an extra check; added doubling/halving/-tupl(e|ed|ing)/multiplied/bi-weekly/bi-monthly/semi-annual/triennial/quadrennial/‰/ppm/ppb/pct to _QUANTITY. Remaining gap: a modifier inside a determiner-led noun phrase before a noun not recognised as a quantity can still be dropped ('the near zorbing' -> 'the zorbing'). Precision costs: 'red dot appeared', 'US DOT said', 8+ digit runs that are not dates, a missing space before an unlisted word, and claims using a function word the source lacks are now flagged or quoted. Ran the new file against a clean export of f370064: 67 failed, 5 passed (the precision and noun-phrase checks plus 3 quantity forms already detected there). After the change: tests/web + tests/assist 2782 passed. graphify not run (as instructed).
